functionality.rationale: The repair changes include ownership only, but the regression gate must prove the capability negotiation source remains buildable.

security.rationale: The repair changes no parsing, authentication, negotiation, or trust-boundary behavior.

performance.rationale: A direct standard-library include changes no generated runtime behavior or performance.

compatibility.rationale: The existing source fails to compile with the supported MSVC toolchain while compiling through incidental transitive includes on libc++.

concurrency.rationale: The repair changes no executable state, ordering, synchronization, or callback behavior.

platform.rationale: GitHub Actions run 31346642027 fails both supported Windows build jobs at the same missing standard-library declaration.

persistence.rationale: The repair does not read, write, migrate, or delete persisted data.

adr.rationale: Restoring direct include ownership changes no public contract or expensive-to-reverse decision.

architecture.rationale: The repair leaves all module, target, dependency, and ownership boundaries unchanged.

roadmap.rationale: The repair restores an already accepted Windows build contract and adds no roadmap behavior.

defect.symptom: The supported Windows native and desktop bundle builds fail while compiling session capability negotiation.
defect.expected_contract: The CI workflow requires native and desktop bundle builds to compile on windows-2022, and each C++ translation unit must directly include the standard declarations it uses.
defect.actual_behavior: MSVC reports C2039 and C3861 for std::back_inserter in native/src/session/wire.cpp, followed by C2672 for std::set_intersection.
defect.trigger: Compile xnn_transfer_session from acceptance commit 73148833a0db947f49183b5e6b61646adc8d077d with MSVC 14.44 on windows-2022.
defect.failure_fingerprint: FAILED: session wire must directly include iterator for std::back_inserter
